title: U-shaped encoding condition
statement: For a Boolean string $x$ and natural numbers $n,s,t$, define the U-shaped encoding condition to hold when all of the following are satisfied: $x$ has the unary-rest property at offset $0$ and length $n$; it has the matrix-rest property at parameters $n,0$; $s<n$; the double encoding at offset $2n+2+2n^2+2$ represents the binary expansion of $s$; $t<n$; and the plain encoding at offset $2n+2+2n^2+2+2\lvert\mathrm{bits}(s)\rvert+2$ represents the binary expansion of $t$.
hypotheses_covered: Double encoding of the binary expansion of $s$ at the stated offset
Plain encoding of the binary expansion of $t$ at the stated offset
caveat: The definitions of the unary-rest, matrix-rest, double-encoding, and plain-encoding predicates are absent, so their precise meanings cannot be supplied.
